summary.intent: Fix failing CI runs on the cipher-box desktop e2e tests after merging #536, which surfaced a new error: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED from the ipns package.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified (CJS context forcing require() on ESM-only ipns package) and fixed by renaming three helper scripts from .ts to .mts, forcing ESM execution. All references updated, typecheck and eslint verified clean, committed on feature branch.

repo: packages/sdk-core has no 'type': 'module', so tsx runs .ts files there as CJS, converting imports to require() calls which break ESM-only packages like ipns@10
tests/e2e-helpers and tests/desktop-e2e both have 'type': 'module' but packages/sdk-core/scripts/ did not — this was the gap introduced when #532/#536 migrated from .mjs helpers
@cipherbox/core CJS dist (packages/core/dist/index.js lines 777, 814) does require('ipns'), but ipns@10's exports map only has types+import conditions, no require/default
tsconfig.scripts.json uses a *.ts glob that silently drops .mts files — required explicit update to include *.mts to prevent untyped drift
The fix/desktop-e2e-helper-script-module-resolution branch was byte-identical to main at the time of investigation — it had not yet addressed the deeper ipns error

code.finding: CJS build of @cipherbox/core calls require('ipns') which fails because ipns@10 is ESM-only
Renamed to .mts to force ESM context and avoid CJS require() of ipns
Renamed to .mts for same ESM reason
Renamed to .mts for same ESM reason
Include glob updated from *.ts to also cover *.mts so renamed helpers are typechecked

workflow: Adding a bare package.json with only {"type":"module"} in a subdirectory breaks ESM self-referencing of the parent package (loses name+exports); .mts extension rename is the cleaner surgical fix
tsx runs files as CJS or ESM based on the nearest package.json's type field — .mts extension overrides this to always use ESM regardless of package.json
Reproducing CI failures locally with pnpm exec tsx (exact CI invocation) is faster than reading CI logs when the error is import/resolution-related
After renaming to .mts, must verify the tsconfig include glob explicitly covers the new extension to avoid silent typecheck gaps

friction: CI failure was on a branch that was byte-identical to main, causing initial confusion about whether a fix was already in progress
Local ipns@10.1.3 had the '.' export so the error appeared non-reproducible until the CJS vs ESM context difference was identified
Edit tool calls failed initially because files weren't Read first — required a second pass to Read then re-apply all edits
test-cross-client-sync.sh and test-cross-client-sync.ps1 each required multiple Edit calls due to multiple references per file
open_items: The feature branch fix/desktop-e2e-helper-script-module-resolution needs to be pushed and a PR opened against main

The underlying issue — @cipherbox/core shipping a CJS build that require()s ESM-only packages — is a latent risk for any other CJS consumer; could be addressed by making core ESM-only or adding require conditions to the ipns re-export
.mjs desktop E2E helper scripts (noted in existing memory) still bypass tsc/eslint; the .mts rename only fixed the sdk-core/scripts helpers, not the broader pattern
